text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, during training...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...This is getting old. If we keep up these
same
trials, we're just going to get the
same results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If we want to switch up our way of
thinking, now
would be a good time to
gather some fresh data
and incorporate
it into our routine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The track would be fully booked today. What a joke. How're we gonna get new data now?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's not a bad idea, but we'll waste
time getting
there. Hang on.
choice_data_list: レース場に見学にでも行く？

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How about this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sends that message to the Ritto
Dormitory
group chat. It just looks like
idle chitchat to me,
so I have no idea
what she's planning.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just keep quiet and you'll understand.
Let's kill
some time with a basic workout
in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Essentially, this is all courtesy of Spe!
Now, let
the taiyaki tea party begin!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nooo, my precious taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We didn't have much choice, Spe. It's
one thing
to take Shakur's bait, but you
bought so many.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you ate them all by yourself, you'd fall
way out
of racing weight.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Apologies for taking your taiyaki, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's fine! It was my idea, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're sure. I do have to say it
was a
brilliant idea. Look how happy
everyone looks!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! I figured even if I only get to
eat a bit,
it's all worth it if everyone can
enjoy and dig in.
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whew!
That taiyaki was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I got dragged into this easier than I care
to admit.
No big deal, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That said, I ended up consuming more
calories
than I expected. I'll need to find
a way to make
up for it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! How about we all do some
training
together? ☆

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hm...  good idea. Running should help us
digest
as well.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Not only is it delicious, but it's
giving
us a chance to train—this taiyaki
really is
marvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Awww man! If I'd known we were going
to run
after, I'd have eaten another one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You really don't learn, do you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna run and run and
make
everyone's lives more marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I admire your enthusiasm, but don't
forget to
warm up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After waiting for a little while with Air
Shakur, I
notice Umamusume starting to
gather at the
training track.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha! You look confused. You know what
they say
about when a butterfly flaps its
wings, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I guess she's saying that the
message
she sent to the group chat
earlier has resulted in
everyone
gathering here now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Don't tell me you think I'm gonna
go link arms
and train with them or
somethin'.
choice_data_list: これでいろんなトレーニングができるな！
これでいろんなトレーニングができるね！
着眼点が普通じゃない……！

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Think efficiently. Sending a message
with a single
line worked like a charm,
and with this many
Umamusume
gathered here...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It'll be way more efficient to observe
and acquire
data from afar than to
challenge them one by
one.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even people who don't usually run
together are
here, so we've got quite a
good dataset.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You keep your eyes on them too, got it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's incident turns out to be yet
another
reminder of how I can't keep up
with Air Shakur's
intellect.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so. But if you break it down
into
numbers, anyone could figure it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Some people might call it unrealistic or
even
reckless... but those people are
only limiting their
own potential.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I'm talking too much. Forget about
that, we
ne—hm?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What's up? ...Ah, you thought it looks
fun? Do
you want to run with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What's the big idea, Cafe? Why'd
you
suddenly veer off the path?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. It's not every day you see this
many
Umamusume training together. It
might be a good
idea to observe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! Those two weren't invited...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Meh, whatever. It's still a chance to
score some
data.
Keep an eye on them
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's incident ends up really
reiterating how
sharp Air Shakur's
tactical thinking is.
